Name: Pilot
Dialog: (while an airplane makes its landing) Ladies and gentlemen, we'll be touching down in Hawaii momentarily, but remember aloha means "hello" and "good bye". Try not to get the two confused.

Name: Wahanies
Dialog: Aloha!

Name: Candace, Lawrence, Linda, Ferb, and Phineas
Dialog: Aloha!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I do hope that was hello.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I always wanted a vacation this close to a volcanic hot-spot. Do you smell what I smell, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (sniffs) Hmm-mmm. Magma.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your father and I are looking forward to the Annual Couple's Surfing Contest.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I can't wait to wipe out!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Dear, "wipe out" means falling off the board.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, I know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, there's only one thing I'm saying hello-ha to! Relaxing! And taking a break from trying to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? It's hard work!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, kids. Let's check out the gift shop while your father checks us in.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I'm a little rusty on my Hawaiian, but here goes. Buenos dias, señor. Me llamo Lawrence. (Spanish: Good day, sir. My name is Lawrence.)

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Oh, no, no. That's not necessary. We speak English here. Hawaii is part of the United States.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Is it really? (pauses) How remarkable. Well, we're the Flynn-Fletcher family. Two adults, three children, (holding up a pet carrier with Perry inside it) and our pet platypus, Perry.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Excellent. Why don't you join your family while I get the bellhop to attend to your bags?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wonderful.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (on the phone) Help desk. Can we get a bell person to pick up a family's bags and platypus. (pauses, then notices the now empty pet carrier) Oh, hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (via a screen on a Tiki statue) Aloha, Agent P. I see you were able to subliminally persuade your host family to take their vacation in Hawaii. Still have no idea how you managed to do that.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, I'll decide where we go on vacation as soon as I clean out Perry's litter box. (looks into the litter box with the Hawaiian islands drawn on it) Hey, how about Hawaii?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As you know, Doofenshmirtz is in the area of the Big Island. He's obviously up to no good. Find out what's he up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh... I promised Carl you'd get him one of those hula wigglers for his dashboard. He thinks it would be "neat."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, what's this? Pineapple scented serenity lotion with SPF. "Apply and feel instantly serene". (to Linda) Mom! I totally need the serenity lotion!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check this out. "Aqua Primates". A-Primes, Ferb. (flips the box over) The back of the box shows them crowning the queen, fighting robots, and designing websites. Ferb, we totally got to get this! Hey, not to be redundant, but... Where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Well, first of all, I just want to state for the record that this island was not my first choice. I wanted Skull Island right over there, but it was already booked for Jacob Bernstein's Bar Mitzvah, and so all that was available was... Pink Unicorn Island.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So go ahead, laugh it up. (Perry smirks) I will say this, it was considerably cheaper than Skull Island and look! (holds up a pink bathrobe with a pink unicorn embroidered on it) I get to keep the robe! (drops the bathrobe) Oh, where are my manners! Aloha! (drapes a lei over Perry) That's Hawaiian for... (the lei quickly binds Perry, who glares at him) you're trapped! And why am I here, you ask? See these little, mini volcanoes? They contain a certain primordial ooze that I need for my latest evil device. Behold, the De-Evolutionator! I-I-I... don't know why it kind of looks like a giant fish bone. That's just how it came in the kit. (pours the ooze into a pan, then tosses the bucket) When I unleash this baby on the Tri-State Area, it will make every man, woman, and child moonwalk backwards down the evolutionary chain, finally stopping at a wimpy little Pliopithecus. (Mocking voice) Ooo, I'm Pliopithecus. I'm not evolved enough to stop a modern man like Doofenshmirtz. (laughs) And that's when I will swoop back into town and take over. Isn't that just Darwin?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Preparing to relax. (walks out of the hotel) Boy, do I need this.... Ugh, why are there so many people here? Wait! Wait! One last chair! (Leaps onto the chair...before getting sat on by the guy who WAS going to sit there) Excuse me! I was here first!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Relaxation.... Come to me, serenity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Well, the A-Primes hatched, but they're really tiny. And it looks like they can only do one trick: moving towards a light source. As impressive as that is, I bet if they were human sized, they could do all this stuff on the box. Hmmm. Ferb, do we have any more of that growth elixir?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I don't care if it's a Ferris wheel to Jupiter or a bionic meatloaf. I'm going to relax. Now go ahead. Run along.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Time to dump them in.

Name: Lifeguard
Dialog: Hey, what are you two kids doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're putting our A-Primes in the pool before they outgrow their container. Is that against the rules?

Name: Lifeguard
Dialog: Well, let's see. (reads the rules from a board) "No running, diving, pushing, or modern expressionism". Nope, nothing here. You guys are good to go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. (at Ferb) Let's add the A-Primes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, Candace. You're finally doing it. Relaxing. It's all good.

Name: Yoga Instructor
Dialog: Aloha, molihini, or guests. In the spirit of lalauea, or peaceful relaxation, let me be your kumu, or teacher, in an outdoor yoga class free for hotel guests.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pathetic, isn't it? Some people don't have the discipline to relax on their own. They need to take a— Oh, who are you kidding? You're taking the class. A little extra serenity can't hurt. (covers herself with the serenity lotion) Oh, this stuff is slippery!

Name: Yoga Instructor
Dialog: Everybody, find a mat. So, let's start with a gentle standing back bend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! (falls backwards into the pool)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, oh! Improbable creature wrangling time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew it! I knew my obnoxious brothers would ruin my relaxation!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shooing some cats away) Shoo, shoo! Get out of here! It's not a real fish! (at Perry) As I was saying, the De-Evolutionator will blast past the Pacific Ocean, bounce off the satellite, and completely blanket the Tri-State area, de-evolving everyone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How are we doing in the back row? Can you see okay? Alright; away we go! (turns the knob on a controller to "de-evolve", but nothing happens) Oh, for badness sake! What now? (climbs up to the lens) Oh, I see. It's.. it's just a little smear on the lens. If I just... (wipes away the smear)

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (to the A-Primes) Oh, um, excuse me. Excuse me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, mister. Have you seen a group of giant, wet aqua primates running through here?

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (pointing to the right) Elevator!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You two are so busted!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Hold it right there, young lady! I'm the manager of this hotel, and if there's going to be any busting to do, I'm going to do it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... but... but... but... Wait, a minute. I am on vacation, he is working. I pass the bust baton to you, sir! Aloha! (sighs in contentment)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (while he and Ferb chase after the A-Primes in a Scooby-Doo style doorway sequence) Come back here! Stop!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Stop right there, young men! What is the meaning of this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh... I'm not sure I understand your question.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (at the A-Primes) Stop! Come back here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. For someone living in Hawaii, he's awfully stressed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (noticing the size of his right ear) Okay. This I don't even get.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, Candace. You're finally doing it. Relaxing.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (to the A-Primes) Come back here! Stop!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are we going to round up the A-Primes?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hello? Room service?

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Boys! I'm going to call your mother!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (via recording) Hello, you've reached Linda Flynn-Fletcher, and if this is Candace, I'm sure what ever the boys are doing, is nothing.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (growls in frustration)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, Doc. Goldberg and his old lady are trying to drop in our wave.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooo, those crazy kooks! I'll just do an old-school drop knee-turn on the bottom, eh? Cut back up the face, through the sloop, do a nice little tail slide, and drop into the green room for a bit of tube time.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You got all that on the Internet, didn't you?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes I did.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cowabunga!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What is it? Oh, great. Now I'm a single-celled organism. Now how am I going to drive home?

Name: Hotel Worker
Dialog: You boys order a giant flashlight from room service?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Hotel Worker
Dialog: You're in luck. We were just about to take that off the menu.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (signs the form then hands it to the hotel worker) Here. (at Ferb) Let's switch this baby on. (switches the giant flashlight on) Hopefully the A-Primes haven't forgotten their one trick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! They're moving towards the light.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Are you Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Your boys are doing something in the back, and you have to see it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, wait! Don't throw that out! No! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Perfect. They're still here. (to Linda) Come quick! Come look! .... See? Look at these slimy, disgusting creatures.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that's not a very nice thing to say.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggling) Yeah.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: But but but but... but there were all these...

Name: Linda
Dialog: My apologies if my daughter put you up to this. (at the boys and Candace) We'll be upstairs, kids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, dude. I know, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm starting to get the hang of it. I think this motion refers to the swaying of the palm trees.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yeah; and this motion says this Brit can move it! I wonder how the boys are doing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nicely done, bro. We are becoming quite the islanders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at a sand sculpture of Jeremy) Oh, Jeremy. I must be the luckiest girl in Hawaii.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is that? (picks up tiki charm and puts it on) Ooh, a good luck charm! (mysterious music plays and the tiki charm glows) With its own theme music.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who could've guessed that my De-Evolutionator would backfire on me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright! Put your pseudopods down. Hey, what's that? My De-Evolutionator. Right here on the ocean floor. If it's still working, I can throw it into fast forward, and evolvinate back into my former wickedness! Ah, it's a good thing I installed this molecular scale control panel. It seemed frivolous at the time, but I'm glad I did it. And... (evolves back into his normal self, then swims to a nearby island) Ugh. Phew. It's strange that my underwear and socks evolved with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aloha, bros.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Cool necklace. Where did you get it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, you like it? It's my lucky charm. It was delivered to me by tranquil, Hawaiian waves. What are you up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well; we've done our share of terrain-based activities, so we’re gonna try some semi-aquatic endeavors.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Speaking of semi-aquatic... Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. We still don't know the current whereabouts of Dr. Doofenshmirtz, but we're picking up a strange signal from the island of Wa Ta Lot Ta Hoie. It could be emanating from the missing De-Evolutionator. (folds up the map and we see Monogram is on a floaty chair) You'd better investigate. Good luck, Agent P. (at Carl) Carl, more ice!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Paddles in on his own little floaty) Coming, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: With the De-Evolution-inator back in my hands, I can reverse the settings, and I'll have the most highly evolved brain on earth! (hits himself with the De-Evolutionator, only to have his head swell up, making him fall over) Now that I'm so smart, I don't think it was such a good idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my precious, little good luck charm. I'm so glad I found you. (trips over a tackle box) Whoa! (face plants into the sand) Well. (Gets carried off by a guy caught by a parasailing fella due to his fishing rod catching him) AAAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Single Guy
Dialog: If this wasn't meant to be, someone give me a sign.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (background voice) No, no, no, no, no! (slams into the window)

Name: Single Guy
Dialog: Well that's good enough for me. This single guy is out, peace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Lands in the pool) Oh, my gosh. I could've been killed. I'm so glad I had my lucky charm. You totally saved my life.

Name: Waiter
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Agh! Well I guess that could've been a lot worse, but thanks to my lucky charm I guess-

Name: Candace
Dialog: No worries! I got my lucky charm on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Well, I guess it could've been worse. (Aaand a bird poops on her) Okay, that does it. This thing is totally bad luck. Well; little amulet, this girl doesn't need any more misfortune. So bye-bye, bad luck! (tosses tiki charm into garbage can; mysterious music plays) Over it!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Ooh, nice necklace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!? How’d this get back on! (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) (at a native) Please help me! How do I get rid of this?****

Name: Native
Dialog: You must take it to the island of Wa Ta Lot Ta Hoie to the top of the volcano, and...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course! It can only be destroyed in the fire from which it was formed. Hold on, volcano! I'm a-comin'!

Name: Native
Dialog: We work for tips, you know! (at himself) And, she's gone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, I need a ride to Wa Ta Lot Ta Hoie?

Name: Man
Dialog: Sure, just grab that tow line.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tow line? Do you mean... thiIIIIIS? (She gets pulled by the jetski but they get seperated) Hey, wait! Why is this happening to me? No more bad luck!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, sis. Way to hang loose!

Name: Laird
Dialog: Cowabunga, kids!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Laird Hamilton?

Name: Laird
Dialog: Last I checked. Say, aren't you dudes a little young to be riding this kinda surf?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No worries, bro! We're just gonna hot dog this honker past the bone-yard to the sand.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got that off the Internet, didn't you?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes, yes I did.

Name: Laird
Dialog: Alright, then. Hang loose, kooks. (at Candace) Later, wahanie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang ten, water man! (at Candace) See you on shore, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm doomed. (ends up on shore with a manta ray stuck to her head) I'm cursed. (at the boys) Phineas, Ferb, I need your help. I can't get rid of this tiki charm.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, personally I'd be a little more worried about that manta ray stuck to your head.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? (looks up) Ugh. You know, with the day I've been having, I didn't even notice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here, Candace. Let's us get rid of it for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That won't work. Every time I try to get rid of it, my luck gets even worse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries, Candace. (takes the tiki charm from her then tosses it away) See? Nothing! No bad luck. Perfectly fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But-but-but-but-but-but-but-but

Name: Laird
Dialog: Wow, you got pounded. Let me give you a hand. (pulls the manta ray off Candace's head then throws it into the water) Looks like you could use a little luck. (gives Candace the tiki charm) Here, I found this on the beach. (at the boys) Later, dawgs.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Later, brah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, it's back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What can we do to help?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We need to get to the top of that volcano and throw it in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well alright then. I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Being stranded on a deserted island is much easier with a normal sized head. Oh, I got something. (Sees Perry) It works! I found a platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Perry the Platypus!?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just because we're stranded on a desert island, doesn't mean we should abandon our normal lives, don't you think? Because then the Tiki gods would win! (pauses) So, I made myself supreme ruler of the Tri-Coconut Area when no one was looking. It stretches all the way from that big rock over there where I'm drying my socks and undies to those three coconut trees at the end of the beach. And I have my minions. Look, if they don't obey, I eat them. What's that look? (camera pans to the De-Evolutionator) Oh, you're looking at the De-Evolutionator. Is that why you're here? Well, don't worry about that. I had to disable it. It was doing bad things to my head, man. I keep it around for the crabs. They really seem to like it. (We see the crabs worshipping the inator) I know. Weird, huh? They get all Kubrick-y on it. (notices that Perry escaped from the trap) Hey! Okay, fine! Go it alone! See if I care, but keep your little webbed feet away from my... (a crab pinches his finger) Ow! Ohh! Oh, you're so going to be crab cocktail.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus! I've drawn a line in the sand, and you are not allow to cross this line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooo, refreshments!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Where'd you get that? Could I... Could I have some? (pauses) Wha-Wha-What, the line? (erases part of the line) Oh, no look, I was just kidding about- Look! Look! Look! I-It's not a real line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not a barrier. Aw, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Smarty-pus! (Perry quickly looks up) Behold, the Sand-inator! (Perry glares) I'll bet you're wondering what it does, huh? Huh? Well... Well, it's easy. It causes great, irritating sand to wedge itself into your swim trunks, causing you to chafe and get a rash and have a lousy day at the beach. How do you like...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hah, you don't wear trunks. What is that? A European thing? (gets hit by an incoming wave) Oh, hey it works. I have sand in my trunks and it's really irritating.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I may be starving and dying of thirst, but at least I've got my hovel. What has he got? Nothing! He's a platypus. They've... They've got like... webbed fingers and no opposable thumbs. Practically flippers.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wai-Wai-Wait! Those are my minions! Ohhh! Traitors!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are we there yet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: For safety's sake, I think Ferb and I should check out the scene before you go up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. Whatever you say. I'm not taking any more chances.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's taking them so long? Phineas? Ferb? Oh, no. (Climbs up) Huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (holding some tiki charms) Check it out, Candace. There's tons of these.

Name: Native
Dialog: Hey, wahanie. Looks like you took the long way. Most people just take the escalator, you know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No! I-I can't handle any more bad luck.

Name: Native
Dialog: That's not bad luck. That just means your table's ready. Let's see what other luck it brings you.... Ah, looks someone's getting a free dessert, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way, I don't want anything that necklace brings me. Goodbye, good riddance, Candace is out, peace!

Name: Laird
Dialog: I'll take that free dessert if you're not going to eat it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No thanks. I just glad I (Falls down the escalator) got-rid of-that-bad-luck.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got to get off this island. What I need is a BO-AT, or boat as I'm now been told it's pronounced. (notices Perry, who's loading bags of coconuts onto a boat) Oh, look! A BO-AT- A boat! (at Perry) Ah, Perry the Platypus. I've decided that our efforts would be better spent if we work together to get off the island. Here, l-l-l-let me help with it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hah! You don't mind if I borrow your boat. (laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (emerging from the sand) Nice work, Agent P. Agent W will take it from here. (at Agent W via wristwatch communicator) Rubber ducky is in the water. Over. (at Perry) Uh... What do you say we get something to eat? I hear there's a great restaurant on the other side of the island. (holds up a tiki charm) And  uh, I found one of these. Maybe we'll get a free dessert.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah! Ow! Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha, hah! So long, Perry the Sucker-pus! Look after my minions! (at himself) Those little traitors! (pauses) Oh, for crying out loud!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (at a coconut and a pelican) Listen up, both of you. Let's get one thing straight. I am supreme ruler of this place and don't you forget it!
